name: Be.Live
description: Be.Live is a browser-based live-streaming, multistream distribution, production, audience-engagement, recording, editing, and content-repurposing platform. Creators and teams use it to brand shows, manage destinations and guests, feature comments and widgets, broadcast live, and reuse finished media.
agentUseSummary: Be.Live cannot currently be connected through Relay. Be.Live publishes interactive browser workflows rather than a third-party developer contract, and its terms prohibit bots, automated access, third-party aggregation access, and access through interfaces other than those Be.Live provides.

blocked.label: Connect Be.Live
blocked.description: Be.Live publishes no self-service third-party application, authentication, scope, token, endpoint, event, revocation, rate-limit, or account-binding contract for Relay.

blocked.label: Read private Be.Live data
blocked.description: Studios, scheduled and completed streams, destinations, guests, teams, comments, recordings, analytics, media, brands, widgets, products, and private links remain unavailable.

blocked.label: Operate broadcasts
blocked.description: Creating, scheduling, configuring, starting, ending, duplicating, or deleting broadcasts and destinations is blocked.

blocked.label: Produce or distribute content
blocked.description: Uploading media, controlling cameras or guests, changing layouts or branding, multistreaming, publishing comments, operating widgets, downloading recordings, editing, exporting, and repurposing content are blocked.

blocked.label: Handle streaming secrets or private links
blocked.description: RTMP stream keys, destination credentials, social-network tokens, session cookies, guest links, and temporary OBS or Ecamm overlay URLs never enter agent inputs or results.

blocked.label: Administer Be.Live
blocked.description: Account, team, role, subscription, billing, storage, destination, social-network, audience, and privacy administration is blocked.

blocked.label: Use private Be.Live interfaces
blocked.description: Password or verification-code capture, browser automation, bots, session replay, scraping, crawling, private or undocumented APIs, third-party aggregation access, reverse engineering, and raw exports are blocked.

providerSetup.blocker: Be.Live publishes product, help, terms, and privacy materials but no self-service third-party developer application, authentication, authorization, endpoint, webhook, revocation, rate-limit, or exact-account contract. Its terms expressly prohibit bots and automated access, access through third-party aggregation services, and access through interfaces other than those Be.Live provides. The documented scheduling, studio, production, overlay, destination, social-network consent, recording, editing, and repurposing flows are interactive customer workflows, not reusable Relay authority. They also carry live-publication, content-rights, participant, social-network, stream-secret, and personal-data obligations.
providerSetup.nextAction: Product, legal, live-production, content, distribution, privacy, security, and customer owners must obtain Be.Live's written authorization for a Relay integration and its current third-party API, application, commercial, and data-processing contract. Freeze application ownership, authentication and revocation, exact account and team IDs, roles, destinations, broadcasts and lifecycle states, participants and guests, media and content rights, comments and widgets, recordings and retention, publishing approvals, audit, rollback, deletion, rate, plan, and termination rules. Only then may Relay implement typed bounded wrappers and provider acceptance.

evidence.supports: Be.Live describes a browser-based product for multistreaming, branding, audience comments and widgets, editing, and content repurposing, but exposes no developer or API entry point.
Be.Live documents scheduling, destinations, cover media, titles, studio staging, start and stop controls, comments, and plan-dependent multistream limits as signed-in interactive browser steps.

Be.Live documents manually generated OBS and Ecamm overlay links that expire after 24 hours, plus customer-supplied Amazon stream keys and interactive control across multiple products; these are not third-party account API authority.
Be.Live documents social-network consent granted specifically to Be.Live for posting streams and reading comments; that grant cannot be reused as Relay authority.

Be.Live's terms prohibit automated systems, bots, scraping, crawling, third-party aggregation access, and access through interfaces other than those Be.Live provides, while assigning users responsibility for content and social-network compliance.
Be.Live's privacy policy covers user-generated audiovisual content, comments, messages, social-network profile data and tokens, device data, and other personal information involved in broadcasts.
